title: The First Clue
description: Plot: Major clue discovery, Act I climax revelation that the thief is still in the academy | Emotion: Triumph of discovery mixed with new urgency and danger | Setting: Hidden passages and secret areas of the academy at Evening, same day | Characters: Princess Luna, Princess Ruby, Princess Sage, Headmistress Aurora, All unicorn partners, Brief appearances by other students
lyrics:
Follow the trail where it leads us
Through the shadows and the stone
Every clue that we discover
Shows we're not here alone

Someone's been watching and waiting
Someone's been planning their move
But we're not backing down now
We've got something to prove

Follow the trail, follow the trail
Through the mystery and the night
Follow the trail, follow the trail
We're gonna bring truth to light

Every step that we take forward
Every door that we unlock
Shows us that together
We're solid as a rock

Follow the trail, follow the trail
We're not turning back now
Follow the trail, follow the trail
We'll solve this mystery somehow

RUBY:
Every passage that we're mapping

SAGE:
Every clue that we decode

RUBY:
Shows us how to catch the culprit

SAGE:
At the end of this dark road

BOTH:
We're not just students anymore
We're detectives on the case
And we won't stop searching
Till we see the villain's face

AURORA:
I wanted to protect you
Keep you safe from any harm
But I see now that your courage
Is your greatest charm

You're not children to be sheltered
You're young women, brave and true
And I'm proud to stand beside you
In whatever we go through

STARDUST:
In the starlight, I can see

BLAZE:
In the fire, I can feel

WHISPER:
In the memory, I know

ALL UNICORNS:
This mystery is real

But our magic's strong together
And our bond will see us through
When we follow where truth leads us
There's nothing we can't do

ALL:
Follow the trail, follow the trail
Through the mystery and the night
Follow the trail, follow the trail
We're gonna bring truth to light

Every friendship that we're building
Every courage that we find
Shows us that together
We can free the troubled mind

Follow the trail, follow the trail
We're not turning back now
Follow the trail, follow the trail
We'll solve this mystery somehow

(Building to climax)
The truth is waiting for us
At the end of this dark road
Follow the trail, follow the trail
Till the mystery's been told!
stage_directions: Character Development. The hidden passages behind Rainbow Academy's walls are revealed in full for the first time. Ancient stone corridors wind between the academy's rooms, lit by magical crystals that respond to the characters' presence. The passages are older than the academy itself, suggesting they were built into an existing structure.. Maps carved into the walls show the full extent of the passage network. Some areas are well-maintained, others covered in dust and cobwebs. The passages feel both magical and slightly ominous - a hidden world within the familiar academy.
